content.value_statement: Unsafe placements can waste ad spend and damage brand trust before campaigns launch. This skill turns placement reports and brand rules into exclusion plans and A1 audit evidence.
actual_capabilities: Builds placement, site, app, channel, and network exclusion plans.
Lists content-suitability tiers and sensitive-topic blocks from brand rules.
Packages A1 brand and placement safety evidence for an auditor.
References existing audience exclusion sets without redefining them.
Flags missing placement reports as NEEDS_INPUT.
limitations: Does not compute RQS scores or issue A1 verdicts.
Requires a placements report to create complete A1 evidence.
Keyed ad APIs are optional and not required.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Exclusions
use_cases.description: Create placement, network, and topic exclusions before a paid media campaign goes live.

use_cases.title: Review Placement Waste
use_cases.description: Convert a placements report into exclusion decisions with clear reasons.

use_cases.title: Package Audit Evidence
use_cases.description: Prepare A1 brand-safety evidence for a separate account audit workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Start From Campaign Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Build brand-safety exclusion lists for my [goal] campaign on [platform]. Brand rules: [constraints]. Placements report: [paste or attach].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze A Placement Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of exported placement data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this placements report for [account or campaign]. Identify sites, apps, channels, networks, and topics to exclude with one reason each.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Audience Exclusions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate handoff with an existing audience suppression set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this audience exclusion set as a dependency: [summary or path]. Build placement and content exclusions that do not conflict with it.

prompt_templates.title: Package Auditor Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Package A1 brand and placement safety evidence from these placements and campaign exports. Include exclusion decisions, rationale, dependencies, and missing inputs.

output_examples.input: A campaign goal, brand constraints, and a pasted placements report.
output_examples.output: A ranked exclusion plan with site and app removals, network opt-out decisions, sensitive-topic blocks, and an A1 evidence handoff.

output_examples.input: A placements report is missing before launch.
output_examples.output: A NEEDS_INPUT status that requests the placements export and avoids creating incomplete A1 evidence.

output_examples.input: An existing audience exclusion set from a related workflow.
output_examples.output: A placement and content exclusion plan that references the audience set and flags conflicts.

best_practices: Provide the placements report before asking for A1 evidence.
State sensitive-topic rules and named blocklists at the start.
Send the packaged evidence to the auditor skill for scoring.
anti_patterns: Do not ask this skill to create targeted audiences.
Do not treat missing placement data as safe by default.
Do not ask this skill to issue the final A1 verdict.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, platform, brand-safety constraints, placements report, and any existing audience exclusion set.

faq.question: Can it work without a placements report?
faq.answer: It can draft constraints, but complete A1 evidence requires the placements report.

faq.question: Does it build target audiences?
faq.answer: No. It references audience exclusions from the dedicated audience workflow.

faq.question: Does it score the account?
faq.answer: No. It packages evidence for an auditor skill that performs scoring.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports platform-agnostic placement exports from common ad managers and optional API-assisted workflows.

faq.question: Can it save results?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for user confirmation before saving a reusable exclusion summary.
